name: genpark-personal-agent-prescription-refill-interaction-sentinel-skill
title: Prescription Refill & Drug Interaction Sentinel Skill
description: Chronic prescription medication schedule tracker, remaining dosage depletion countdown, automated pharmacy refill order triggers, and clinical drug-drug interaction (DDI) severity checker. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: track_medication_refill_burn_rate
tools.description: Calculate remaining dosage days based on daily frequency, current quantity on hand, and recommend optimal pharmacy refill dispatch date.

tools.name: cross_check_drug_interactions
tools.description: Screen concurrent active medications against known contraindicated pharmacology pairs (e.g. blood thinners + NSAIDs, SSRIs + MAOIs).
